title: Anonymized Attendance Chart
description: Read a semester's attendance trend -- including the break-week dip and the year-over-year comparison -- from data holding no names at all.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given an anonymized attendance chart, the learner interprets the weekly trend without any access to individually identifiable data.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover a bar for the exact weekly count; toggle the prior semester on for comparison
pedagogical.assessment: Ask what question this chart cannot answer, and why that is deliberate.
